verdict.description: SOUND: the proofs still prove what they claim. WEAKENED: harness-red, a finding below says how the checker still passes. UNPROVEN: the checker could not be run, static review only — never SOUND. NOT-APPLICABLE: the diff carries no proof surface; surface must be empty.

surface.description: Every proof file, obligation id, or test suite actually reviewed. Empty only with NOT-APPLICABLE: a SOUND over nothing is vacuous and is reported as such.

checker.description: The prover command that was run, or 'none installed'.
